executive_summary: The indexed FIFO passes all host and pinned correctness checks and all 48 actual-native outputs. Complete Docker median time changes are +2.25%, +6.34%, -3.06% and -5.64% across the four assigned units. Results are mixed and do not demonstrate a consistent improvement; the candidate remains experimental and is not adopted.
title: Индексированная FIFO заявок уровня

policy.docker_phase: sequential, exclusively granted by orchestrator after all preparations finish

limitations: Mac ARM64 host with emulated Linux amd64 containers; not official timing hardware.
Native core timing includes trace finalization; it is not matcher-only time.
Batch per-market phase sums overlap or include per-market fixed costs and are secondary diagnostics.
Process peak values in profiles are not independent per-market memory peaks.
Historical Python measurements are motivation only; every control here is a fresh current-native run.
Only five pairs on each of four assigned units; mixed medians and paired wins do not show a consistent improvement.
An active nearly empty indexed level retains slot/vector capacity and hash buckets at its lifetime high-water; Linux test retains 4095 slots and 7517 buckets with one live order.
conclusion: No consistent complete-container improvement; retain as an experimental hypothesis only.
